conclusion: The confirmed severe slowdown is frame delivery in windowed Composed: Copy with GPU GDI, shared by 2D and cheap/vertical/outside-map views. Rendering continued near240 FPS while only2-7 FPS reached display in several five-second intervals. Native fullscreen switches this host to Hardware: Legacy Flip and removes that drop. The precise Windows/NVIDIA driver defect is not identified; this is a verified presentation-path workaround, not a camera math/terrain optimization.
fix: Play-FPV initializes native fullscreen once with exact binary settings backup and all unrelated preferences verified unchanged. Native UI choices thereafter persist; explicit Windowed and Restore launchers remain available. Accepted gameplay JAR/fingerprint remains unchanged; no simulation or multiplayer protocol edit.
methodLimits: First live capture overlapped the Java test suite and is excluded from clean before/after presentation comparisons.

Explicit saved VSync=true did not resolve symptoms or change presentation path. The original vsync key was absent and native UI default is true; do not infer that initial swap interval was0 from the earlier diagnostic fallback.
Fullscreen can change viewport dimensions. This comparison validates frame delivery, not a renderer geometry/FPS speedup at fixed resolution.

Five-second windows are elapsed from first ETW present; they are not individually tagged with exact player pitch. The player repeated2D/horizon/vertical/return and confirmed all views worked after fullscreen.
First five seconds include startup/load and are excluded from steady results.
OpenGL GPU metrics become unavailable in the Legacy Flip trace; no GPU-time reduction claim.
Part timers are nested; do not sum them. Count-only reflective GL runs are excluded from timing/allocations claims.
Scripted fixtures pin the pilot and disable waves/fog in copied data; physical foreground ETW sessions preserve ordinary gameplay.
No new two-client multiplayer run; accepted byte-identical JAR remains installed.
